abstract: In this report, photo-induced in-plane alignments of nematic liquid crystal (LC) molecules, 5CB, have been investigated in LC cells prepared with alternate Direct Red 80 (DR80 : azo dye) and poly(diallyldimethylammonium chloride) (PDADMAC) self-assembled films on gold electrodes using the attenuated total reflection (ATR) measurement method. From the ATR curves, in-plane switching properties and alignment of the LC molecules in the LC cells were evaluated during and after irradiation with linearly polarized light.

articleTitle: Application of dielectric interlayer polarization in dielectric testing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper researches the influence of an interlayer polarization about the dielectric characteristics of the multi-layer dielectric bodies. By using a physical model to simulate interlayer polarization found testing the tg /spl delta/-f of a multi-layer dielectric body could hardly detect the dielectric deficiency of some layer. And according to the character of multi-layer dielectric bodies, a higher sensibility dielectric testing method that uses absorbing current is put forward theoretically.

articleTitle: Evaluation of streaming electrification considering circulation of charged oil
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Streaming electrification occurs when the insulated oil passes through the ducts of insulating paper in a transformer. While the generated electrostatic charge circulates, a high voltage can build up at some parts. In the case that an extremely low conductivity oil is used, the voltage increases because of the large relaxation time. If the relaxation time is comparable to the circulation time of oil, the electrostatic charge accumulates increasing the voltage further. This paper is concerned with the effect of the macroscopic electrostatic charge accumulation. The charge relaxation process is observed experimentally. Based on the relaxation relation, the charge density and voltage rise are evaluated for actual transformers.

articleTitle: Pattern recognition of partial discharge on generator stators by using model bars
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Partial discharge (PD) can indicate defects in insulation of generator stator windings. In this paper, some generator model bars were made and some typical PD phenomena in generator stator windings were simulated. PD tests were also tried to find the features of composite PD. The data obtained from the test were analyzed and the spectrums of different types of PD were plotted using statistical parameters to reveal the feature of different patterns of PD. A BP neural network was also used to recognize the PD patterns.

articleTitle: Electronic energy states at conducting polymer/electrode interfaces studied by atmospheric photoemission spectroscopy and Kelvin probe method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The energy states at conducting polymer/electrode interfaces have been observed by methods of measuring in the atmosphere. The Fermi level (E/sub F/) of the conducting polymer on several electrode materials was estimated using the Kelvin probe method and the ionization potential (IP) was estimated using atmospheric photoelectron spectroscopy. Based on the observations, the electron transfer at the interfaces was related to the difference of the IP between the conducting polymers and electrode material. The dependence of the E/sub F/ of PAT6 on the film thickness differed depending on the electrode materials used, including indium-tin-oxide (ITO), Ag and Al.

articleTitle: Direct measurement just under surface discharge on PMMA by Pockels electric field sensors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Surface discharge is one of the main phenomenons in electric apparatus's fault, but has not yet been cleared. The measurement of electric fields in or near a streamer while surface discharge creeps is greatly helpful for it. There is optical measurement technique for electric fields by using Pockels crystal, and optical waveguide technique has been successfully introduced to miniaturize the sensors. The measurement of electric fields just under surface discharge is tried with the optical waveguide Pockels sensor installed on a PMMA plate and output signals according to its advance are obtained.

articleTitle: Dielectric properties of polyetheretherketone irradiated with electron beam in helium gas
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: After a high dose electron beam was irradiated to polyetheretherketone (PEEK) in helium (He) gas, the temperature dependence of the relative permittivity and the relative dielectric loss factor were measured. Glass transition temperature (T/sub g/) values were calculated from graphs depicting the relationship between logarithmic values of /spl tau/(T/sub m/) data and T/sub m/ values through use of the WLF equation. These results were compared with those of specimens irradiated in the air and the relationship between the atmosphere of the irradiation and electrical properties was investigated.

articleTitle: Studies on compatibility of silicone oil with pressboard insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The paper oil insulation system is an integral and essential part of large power transformers. The failure of power transformers under combined stresses and fast transients has made it necessary to look for an alternate liquid insulant. In this study, silicone oil was investigated for use as a liquid insulant. The samples of pressboard are subjected to dielectric tests like electric strength, surface electric strength under AC, DC and combined AC/DC voltages, dielectric dissipation factor and others. The variation of dielectric constant, dissipation factor of silicone oil has been studied over a range of frequency. The surface electric strengths of cellulosic insulation with silicone oil and with mineral oils have been compared. Some very interesting results on the performance of silicone oils have been observed and discussed.

articleTitle: Digest report of the investigation committee on assessment and improvement of the interface in composite electrical insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele

articleTitle: Study on aging extent of stator insulation in a large turbogenerator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Different portions of stator insulation are subjected to multistresses with different strength during the operation of large generators. In order to study the aging extent of stator insulation in different portions, diagnostic tests are performed on the specimens from stator bars of a large turbogenerator, which has operated for 16 years. The tests include, polarization index test, dielectric loss measurement at various voltages and temperatures, AC current measurement, partial discharge test and acoustic detection. The test results are discussed and it is shown that the aging extent of stator insulation of end windings is more serious than that of the insulation in the slots. Results also indicate that end windings were subjected to stronger stresses than the slot portions of coils were. Finally, the suggestion could be made that during predictive maintenance testing of large turbogenerators, more attention should be drawn to the insulation of endwindings.

articleTitle: Fabrication of hafnium silicate films by plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: According to the guideline of manufacturing processes on the future CMOS technology, the thickness of the gate silicon dioxide is expected to be scaled down to less-than-1 nm in the near future. In this region, silicon dioxide would not maintain the insulating property, since direct tunneling dominates the leakage current. In order to overcome this difficulty, several attempts to increase the physical thickness, while keeping the equivalent silicon dioxide thickness, have been carried out using materials with a higher permittivity. Future gate dielectric materials with a higher permittivity have been requested to possess excellent insulating property, excellent thermal stability at the interface layer with a silicon substrate or electrode, a large band gap with a favorable band structure, and adaptability for semiconductor process technology. We have tried to deposit hafnium silicate films by plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), and have successfully obtained good films. In this report, we briefly describe the developed deposition method and discuss electrical properties and chemical structure of the deposited films.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence properties of hydrogenated amorphous silicon nitride
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: We have investigated time-resolved PL spectra and nanosecond-order PL decay characteristics in silicon-rich a-SiN/sub x/:H film and discussed recombination processes of photogenerated carriers. The PL peak energy shifts to a higher energy as x increases. Time-resolved PL and nanosecond-order PL decay measurements indicate that the photogenerated carriers in the band-tail states recombine first through an exciton-like mechanism and then through a radiative tunneling mechanism as in the cases of near-stoichiometric and nitrogen-rich a-SiN/sub x/:H films.

articleTitle: Relationship between PD characteristics and channel diameter of artificially-simulated tree channel
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In order to clarify the mechanism of partial discharge (PD) in an electrical tree, we investigated PD pulse sequence and PD current shape of an artificially-simulated tree channel in LDPE. The diameters of artificial channels were 30, 50, and 100 /spl mu/m. The number of PD's in a cycle increased with the increase of channel diameter. The width of PD current shape also increased with the increase of channel diameter. The effect of PD characteristics on channel diameter and its mechanism were discussed.

articleTitle: Digest report of cooperative research committee on EINA magazine
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele

articleTitle: On-line monitoring of capacitive electric apparatus using the sum current method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The article describes the application of the sum current method to the on-line monitoring of capacitive equipment, analyses the influence factors to the measurement result, and gives the flowchart for on-line monitoring system.

articleTitle: Performance of cycloaliphatic resin spacers in SF/sub 6/-N/sub 2/ gas mixtures
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Studies have shown that SF/sub 6/-N/sub 2/ gas mixture is a viable alternative to SF/sub 6/ gas for high voltage applications. However, the performance of spacers in gas mixture needs complete evaluation for a better understanding of the long term performance of GIS. This study aims at evaluation of cycloaliphatic resin spacers for applications in SF/sub 6/-N/sub 2/ gas mixtures. Surface flashover across cycloaliphatic resin spacers has been determined under AC, DC, and combined AC-DC voltages and with fixed metallic particles in SF/sub 6/, N/sub 2/ and SF/sub 6/-N/sub 2/ gas mixtures of different proportions. The results show that cycloaliphatic resin cast spacers are good for gas mixture applications but the filler content is required to be altered for achieving better performance under DC and repetitive pulses.

articleTitle: Microwave dielectric properties of MgTiO/sub 3/-BaTiO/sub 3/ ceramics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The (1-x)MgTiO/sub 3/-xBaTiO/sub 3/(X=0.02/spl sim/0.1) ceramics were fabricated by the conventional mixed oxide method. The structural and microwave dielectric properties were investigated by the XRD, SEM, EDS and network analyzer. The sintering temperature and time were 1275/spl deg/C-1350/spl deg/C, 2 hours, respectively. In the XRD results of (1-x)MgTiO/sub 3/-xBaTiO/sub 3/ ceramics, the hexagonal BaMg/sub 6/Ti/sub 6/O/sub 19/ and ilmenite MgTiO/sub 3/ structures were coexisted. In the case of the 0.9MgTiO/sub 3/-0.1BaTiO/sub 3/ ceramics sintered at 1325/spl deg/C, dielectric constant, quality factor and temperature coefficient of resonant frequency were 32.67, 32665, -84.5 ppm//spl deg/C, respectively.

articleTitle: Digest report of the investigation committee on insulation lifetime of dielectric materials and electrical apparatus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele

articleTitle: Feature extraction and pattern recognition of multi-source PD signals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Partial discharge signals from industrial models of stator winding bars were used to compose multisource PD patterns, which were represented by 3-D charts. The tabulated data were calculated and served as characteristic features. Pattern recognition was performed using a back-propagation (BP) network. Successful classification of multi-source PD signals showed that tabulated data were sensitive and stable to reflect different PD patterns. The suitability and robustness of the BP network for classification was further verified by analyzing the untrained patterns' recognition.

articleTitle: The flashover characteristics for artificial contaminated insulators in the wet precipitation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Regarding the problems of widespread contamination, flashover occurs in power system insulators. Through a number of tests, the diversity of the flashover voltage (FOV) for contaminated insulators in the different wet precipitation condition is determined, and is analyzed and discussed by the authors. They have their own opinions about wet precipitation.

articleTitle: Digest report of investigation committee on advanced measurement methods on partial discharges in electrical apparatus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Summary form only given. On-line partial discharge (PD) monitors have been intensively developed and commercially available at present. Generally, newly developed monitors tend to adopt higher frequency in detecting circuits to avoid the noise in lower frequency regions. On the other hand, rotating machines have large inductance and capacitance along windings, which cause the deformation of original wave form of PD pulse during propagation from PD source to detecting couplers. So more discussions and cautions are necessary for practical application of the monitors as CBMtools. Recently IEEE Power Engineering Society has issued a new guide IEEE Std 1434-2000 "IEEE Trial-Use Guide to the Measurement of Partial Discharges in Rotating Machinery". The standard involves important and beneficial information especially for maintenance engineers. Dielectric and Electrical Insulation Technical Committee, IEE Japan has also strong concerns on on-line PD measurements of rotating machines with above-mentioned reasons and started a new investigation committee. The new committee started January 16th, 2001 with 20 members from electric power utilities, universities and manufacturers. Based upon the bibliography of IEEE Std 1434, original papers on PD monitoring including Japanese papers are investigated in detail. Final Technical Report will be issued from IEE Japan in 2003.

articleTitle: Study for theory and method of on-line detection of power system transient harmonic
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper describes the theory of on-line detection of power system transient harmonic. A new on-line detection method using RMS (root-mean-square) of harmonics amount as trigger is presented for the first time. The passive sensor applying electric-magnetic isolated method and the synchronous sampling circuits used for tracking the changes of power system frequency are studied and designed. The contrasting analysis of the input wave with the reverse synthetic input wave by detecting results in a laboratory verifies the correctness of this method. Finally, the results of transient harmonic detected in the substation are given.

articleTitle: Relation between the ac loss current method and the PEA method for water-treed length
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Change of ac loss current through a non-penetrated water-treed XLPE sheet sample with applied voltage has been studied based on a model. In the model, the conductance of the water-filled channel layer is assumed to exhibit a nonlinear dependence on voltage. The observed changes of the magnitude and phase of the fundamental current and the third harmonic component can be well fitted by the model. It is found that the length of the water-filled channel layer approaches that of the water-treed region estimated by the PEA method at 2 kV stress. It is also found that the length of the water-filled channel layer obtained by the ac loss current method has a good correlation with the length of the water-treed region estimated by the PEA method.

articleTitle: Engineering challenges for polymer electronics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Polymer LEDs are entering the market and rapid improvements are taking place in the fabrication techniques and the level of sophistication of polymer circuits. However, a number of challenges remain to be overcome before the commercial future of polymer electronics becomes an assured fact. Here, we review briefly the progress made to date in the development of polymer electronics. Then, following a consideration of the more important materials aspects, we proceed to discuss the techniques which are becoming established as the technologies of choice for polymer circuit and system fabrication.

articleTitle: Interference analysis and rejection of partial discharge (PD) monitoring signal on-site
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: According to the waveform and spectrum characteristics, various interferences during on-line PD measurement could be divided into three types such as the sinusoidal continuous noises, pulse shaped interference (including the periodical and stochastical) and background noises (similar to the white noise). Generally speaking, various digital filters could be used to suppress the sinusoidal noise. Some rejection methods for the pulse shaped interference have been developed according to some waveform characteristics and statistical features in the time domain. And the wavelet analysis is a feasible solution to reduce background noises. This paper makes an overall introduction to the anti-interference architecture of a PD monitor and diagnosis system installed in a transformer-generator unit of a power plant in China. Results were also provided in detail of the analysis and rejection for various interferences during on-site PD measurement.

articleTitle: Diagnosis method for high voltage coils based on electrical and tap tone characteristics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: A new diagnosis method for high voltage coils has been developed. In this method, two diagnosis techniques are involved. One is an evaluation method for breakdown voltage based on nondestructive electric characteristics and the other is a delamination detection technique using a neural pattern recognition system for tap tone signals of the insulation layer. The evaluated breakdown voltage value is corrected by a rectifying factor determined from the delamination form of the insulation layer.

articleTitle: Effect of photon irradiation on SBT films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Simultaneous laser irradiation during thermal annealing is effective to lower the crystallization temperature of the perovskite structure. However, the surface of a Sr/sub 2/Bi/sub 2/Ta/sub 2/O/sub 9/ (SBT) film with the perovskite structure obtained by laser irradiation is not as smooth as one obtained by thermal annealing. In order to fabricate SBT films that can be used for ferroelectric memories, we need to reduce the surface damage. In the present research, the effect of photon irradiation on the surface damage of SBT is investigated.

articleTitle: Photoirradiation effects on light-emitting devices using conjugated polymers as emission material
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The photoirradiation effects on the emission characteristics of polymer light-emitting devices (PLEDs) based on conjugated polymer have been studied. In this study, we have used PLEDs with semitransparent Al cathode to accelerate the photooxidation of the emission layer. It was already confirmed that the semitransparent-Al film having optical transmittance /spl sim/30% does not reduce the photooxidation rate of underlying polymer film. When poly(2-methoxy-5-dodecyloxy-1,4-phenylene vinylene) (MDOPPV) is used in the emission layer, the emission intensity at a constant voltage drops significantly. It has been also observed that the photoluminescence quantum efficiency of MDOPPV film significantly reduces by similar photooxidation. On the other hand, the electroluminescence quantum efficiency remains constant. These apparently curious results have been explained by taking the difference in the exciton formation sites between electroluminescence and photoluminescence processes into account.

articleTitle: A novel electrical equipment on-line monitoring system based on geographic information system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Recently more and more single parameter electrical equipment on-line monitoring systems are being put into use. How to rationally fuse the on-line insulation monitoring information of this location dispersed equipment and thus to realize effective management of the on-line monitoring information from them and rationally analyze the specific electrical equipment are the questions which should be solved urgently. Geographic Information System (GIS) is used in this paper for the fusion of the on-line insulation information of the equipment within the different substations and different locations in the same substation and a multi-parameter method is used to analyze the insulation status of the specific electrical equipment. A novel electrical equipment on-line monitoring system with multi-parameters based on GIS is proposed, the means and steps for the construction of this system are explained through examples. Application results show that this method can overall reflect the running status of electrical equipment and greatly reduce the losses caused by sudden faults. Therefore, this method can meet the needs of modern management of power systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of residual lifetime of LDPE degraded radiation by time-temperature superposition method
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: A novel method has been proposed to determine the residual lifetime of low density polyethylene (LDPE) by time-temperature superposition (TTS) using a dynamic mechanical analyzer (DMA). The principle of this new method is to detect the change in response of polymeric materials to multi-frequency dynamic loading over a glass transition interval. LDPE was irradiated with gamma rays up to 1000 kGy at a dose rate of 5 kGy/hr in the presence of air at room temperature. The glass transition temperatures of irradiated samples were tested and compared with TGA and DMA methods. The inter-relationship between TGA and TTS methods for lifetime prediction was investigated. For radiation degradation of polymeric materials, TTS method can be a useful tool to predict the residual lifetime.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet-photon-induced paramagnetic centers in Ge and Sn co-doped silica glass
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: We have examined paramagnetic centers and absorption bands in the visible-to-uv region in Ge and Sn co-doped SiO/sub 2/ glass irradiated with UV photons from a KrF excimer laser. The generation mechanisms, optical properties, and roles in the photo-induced refractive index change of the paramagnetic centers are discussed.

articleTitle: A new analysis of the composite insulator flashover
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The composite insulator is a kind of new insulator developed in the mid 1960s. The faults of the composite insulator have been divided into three kinds including bird streamer flashover, lightning flashover and contamination flashover. The bird streamer is the main fault source that happens during the dynamic defecation processing of birds at dawn. But on the basis of experiments, it is proved that some flashover at dawn is due to the uniform distribution voltage. The dry high voltage part of the composite insulator bears relatively high voltage. When salt solution with different concentration, equal to different parallel resistance, was imbrued on the composite surface nearest to the power line, the distributed voltage of the whole composite insulator would change. The voltages of sheds near the power line increase more than the others. Therefore long-term effect under such conditions induces partial flashover, even power fault. Finally it is suggested that the high voltage part of the composite insulator should be improved.

articleTitle: Photoelectric properties of organic dye LB film cells utilizing surface plasmon excitation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Short-circuit photocurrents (I/sub sc/) were investigated for the merocyanine dye LB photoelectric cells in the attenuated total reflection (ATR) configurations. The I/sub sc/ profiles as a function of incident angle corresponded to the ATR properties in the cells. The optical properties in the cells were calculated. It was estimated that the I/sub sc/ was caused by the strong optical absorption in the cells related to surface plasmon (SP) excitations. It is expected that photocurrents can be enhanced utilizing the SP excitations in the ATR configuration.

articleTitle: State signal and fuzzy membership function of fault diagnosis in electrical equipment
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: It is an effective approach to combine state signal processing with fuzzy mathematics for recognizing fuzziness and randomness clearly. This paper shows how the fuzzy membership functions are obtained from results of signal processing of fault diagnosis in electrical equipment. Hence the properties of electrical equipment are revealed more thoroughly. Finally, this method is proved to be effective by an example.

articleTitle: Blackboard expert system of multi-expert cooperating diagnosis for transformers insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper uses a new knowledge base designed by blackboard prototype to develop an expert system (ES) for transformer fault diagnosis for the first time. According to object-oriented programming (OOP) principle, the knowledge base of this expert system is composed of many modularization components based on artificial neural network (ANN), fuzzy logic (FL), IEC DGA standards and expert experiences, which are core portions of fault diagnosis. The expert system succeeds in diagnosing the transformer's insulation using multi-expert cooperating method. When the expert's opinions are conflicting, original and feasible methods are brought forward to resolve this problem. The implementations are discussed in detail. It is confirmed that the ES is satisfactory in practice.

articleTitle: Study on the interference of humidity and acidity with the insulation ability of 10 kV opening bus
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper reports on the insulation ability of 10 kV opening bus by simulating the practical situation of Xiaolongkan substation in Shapingba district Chongqing City in China. Both the interference from relative humidity (RH=70%, 80%, 90%, 100%) plus acidity(pH=3,4,5,6) and the layout method of bus (horizontal and vertical) were studied to observe the performance of the AC insulation ability of the opening bus, which refers to the composite insulation ability of the air distant between phases and post insulators in this paper. It is found that with increasing RH, the flashover voltage of the bus first increases when RH<80%, then decreases rapidly when RH>80%. At the same time, with increasing pH, the flashover voltage of the bus increases. Moreover, when RH<80%, flashover takes place between phases, and when RH>90%, flashover takes place on the surface of post insulators. Constructive advice concerning the running safety of 10 kV opening buses in power systems is presented.

articleTitle: Conductivity and breakdown of solid dielectrics under the influence of electric and magnetic field
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The range of solid dielectrics available for use in the field of electrical and electronics engineering are wide and properties of these materials are equally diverse. Apart from physical and chemical properties there are other innumerable factors that contribute to the dielectric behaviour of insulating materials. The interaction and interdependence of these factors are so complex that even a century of research work has not rendered any unified approach to the study of process of ionization, conduction and breakdown mechanism in dielectric media. Solid dielectrics as used in the field of electrical and electronics are not only subjected to electric field, but also under the influence of both electric and magnetic fields. Considering this, an attempt has been made in this paper to explain the conductivity of solid dielectric under the influence of both electric and magnetic fields which has not been presented so far in the available literature. A generalised mathematical treatment of conduction current of dielectric materials in the presence of both electric and cross-magnetic field has been also presented.

articleTitle: Effect of pulse propagation characteristics in power transformer on partial discharge recognition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: An experimental method is utilized to investigate the propagation characteristic of discharge pulse and its influence on the recognition of partial discharge in this paper. Firstly, the discharge model tests of common defect in oil-paper insulation are finished. A series of tests are conducted to study the propagation characteristic of discharge pulse along the winding. Thus the identification of discharge waveform could be implemented. The restoring method of the original wave and the extracting method of wave characteristic are also put forward. Finally the backpropagation (BP) neural network is utilized to recognize the wave characteristic of discharge signal. The validity of recognition system is illustrated.

articleTitle: Model of integrative denoise in on-line PD monitoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Based on the summary of the possible disturbances during the detection of the partial discharge (PD) pulses and the relative denoising methods, an improved model of integrative denoise in PD monitoring is proposed. In the model, the analysis of disturbances existed in a specific site is emphasized, which will help to make the denoising measures more efficient and flexible. The denoising result to the measured signal in the lab indicates that it is possible to extract PD signals effectively and hold the most information of the PD pulses, which may be helpful to analyze the PD signals deeply and build a fine fingerprint library, and then improve the classification and recognition of the PD signals.

articleTitle: The influence of sintering temperature on the flashover performance of alumina insulators in vacuum
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper has investigated the trap distribution of alumina ceramics samples prepared under different sintering temperature. Compared with the flashover performance of these samples in vacuum, it was found that the trap distribution could influence the flashover performance. According to the experimental results, there is some relationship between the trap distribution and the surface flashover performance of insulators in vacuum. The role of the trap distribution on the surface flashover in vacuum has been analyzed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic environment of the EHV transmission line and its effect
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Based on the characteristic of electromagnetic field around the EHV transmission line, this paper discusses the effect of electromagnetic environment of the EHV transmission line by analyzing power frequency electric field, magnetic field, radio interference and audio noises. Then this paper studies the lasting effect and transient electric breakdown effect by power frequency electric field to zoology, corona discharge to radio interference, power frequency magnetic field and audio noises to nearby environment. At last, example some limits rule and propose the steps to minish its effect to the environment by analyzing the transmission line electric field distribution rule and its affected factors.

articleTitle: Detecting loose stator wedges in large motors
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper presents test results obtained from studies aimed at determining whether the acoustic method, a nondestructive test technique based on the use of transient stress waves, can be used to detect the loose stator wedges. During the detection, mechanical impact is applied on the wedges and the responses are recorded by a microphone. Frequency analysis is performed in order to provide a description of the signal in frequency domain. It is shown that characteristic frequency in acoustical spectrum is the key to detecting loose stator wedges. Results also show that amplitude of the characteristic frequency increases corresponding to the looseness of wedges. Besides analysis of the test results, this study successfully introduces a thin plate resonator model for analyzing the response of a loose wedge when an impact is performed. The value of characteristic frequency is calculated for better interpretation of the detection results.

articleTitle: Anomalous currents in PMMA/PS double layered films
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Multilayer insulators made of two or more materials with different dielectric constants and conductivities are widely used in power apparatus such as oil impregnated cables and transformers etc.. In such insulators appreciable internal space charge accumulates at their interfaces causing polarization. The local field at the interface may be consequently increased by this polarization when a dc field in applied. Several other distinct dielectric relaxations are also usually present in a polarized insulating system. This multiplicity of polarization is seen most easily in a scan of depolarization current as a function of temperature. Double layered PMMA/PS films of average thickness 20 /spl mu/m prepared by solvent evaporation technique were thermally polarized at temperatures 40, 70, 100 and 130/spl deg/C with fields of 5, 25, 100 and 200 kV/cm. Short circuit TSDC measurements were carried out on these polarized films in two modes i.e. after applying a positive field to the PMMA layer. PMMA (+)/PS(-or grounded), and after applying positive field to the PS layer. PMMA(-)/PS(+). The TSDC thermograms were characterized by several peaks. Anomalous current behaviour was observed at high poling temperatures and high fields for PMMA(+)/PS(-) mode. In case of PMMA(-)/PS(+) mode such anomalous currents were observed even at low temperatures with low field; for high field values current exhibited normal behaviour. The observed phenomena has been interpreted in terms of injected homocharge and Maxwell-Wagner effect.

articleTitle: Electrical and physical evaluation on heterogeneous interfaces between two kinds of XLPE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Two XLPE cables (A, B) and two crosslinkable polyethylene (PE) tapes (A, B) were prepared. By combining XLPE and PE tapes, four different case interfaces were obtained. AA and BB represent the homogeneous interfaces and AB and BA represent the heterogeneous interfaces. The objective of this study was to define characteristics of the interfaces of two kinds of dielectric materials as a cable joint in solid dielectric cable system. AC and impulse voltage were applied in the prepared specimens with termination. The electrical strength of the heterogeneous interfaces was approximately 15% lower than that of homogeneous interfaces. Physical properties (tensile strength, degree of crosslinking and variation of crystallinity) were investigated for these four interfaces. All specimens containing the interface show lower values of about 25% in tensile strength, about 10% in degree of crosslinking compared with bulk parts that represent pure cable insulation or crosslinked polyethylene tape. The homogeneous interface has about 10% higher strength compared to the heterogeneous interface. The difference in electrical performance is presumably caused by the difference of physical properties from different level of chemical bonding with two kinds of XLPE. In addition, crystalline morphology affected the electrical performance.

articleTitle: Study on prediction method of thermal deterioration of pole transformer with overloaded condition
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The purpose of this study is to clarify the characteristic of thermal deterioration of insulating paper used in transformers to construct a prediction method. The authors have clarified the deterioration characteristic of insulating papers, and have constructed a facile prediction method of thermal deterioration of insulating paper throughout this paper. Using this method one can predict the life of pole transformer with any overloaded condition or decide the limit of overload rate with any load pattern.

articleTitle: Study of linear and nonlinear dielectric properties of monolayers by Maxwell-Displacement Current and optical second harmonic generation measurements
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In order to clarify the dielectric properties of organic monolayers at the air-water interface, the formula of polarization of organic monolayers with C/sub /spl infin/v/ symmetry have been derived, using orientational order parameters expressed by Legendre polynomials. It is shown that Maxwell Displacement Current (MDC) measurement coupled with optical second harmonic generation (SHG) measurement is helpful for the determination of these orientational order parameters. Monolayers of liquid crystals on the air-water interface were examined during monolayer compression and the orientational order parameters were determined.

articleTitle: Study on relationship between the current of oil flow electrification and characteristics of solid materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In this paper, the relationship between the current of oil flow electrification in spinning disk system and characteristics of solid materials is investigated. It is found that current of oil flow electrification is related to characteristics of solid materials and surface roughness of pressboard paper.

articleTitle: Influence of oxidation on morphology and electrical properties of LDPE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Investigated the influence of oxidation on morphology and impulse breakdown strength of LDPE. The results are summarized as follows. (1) The peak intensity on [110] plane of XRD pattern is increased with the oxidation. (2) The calculated crystal size for [110] plane from XRD pattern does not depend on the degree of oxidation. (3) impulse breakdown strength at 30/spl deg/C decreases with the progress of oxidation in the low oxidation region, and increases in the high oxidation region. On the other hand, impulse breakdown strength at 90/spl deg/C decreases with the progress of oxidation in the low and high oxidation region. Although the crystallization due to the oxidation is enhanced, it scarcely effects the change of impulse breakdown strength with the progress of oxidation.

articleTitle: Dynamic mechanical analysis of degradation of rotating machine composite insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The long-term accelerated aging tests in laboratory environment has been conducted on the composite insulating materials (CIM) of actual rotating coils subjected combined stresses including thermal, electrical, mechanical and thermal cycling stresses. The dynamic mechanical experiments of CIM has been carried out in the different aging periods using dynamic mechanical analyzer (DMA) and the relationships between mechanical parameters and the aging time of CIM is also analyzed in this paper. Based on the Eyring absolute reaction speed theory, a method calculating the apparent activation energy of glass transition (AAEGT) is developed. By DMA, it has been suggested that the dynamic mechanical parameters, such as dynamic modulus, temperature of glass transition, dynamic mechanical loss peak value, width of half a peak value and apparent activation energy of glass transition can be used to characterize the aging properties of large generator stator composite insulating materials.

articleTitle: Multiple surface plasmon excitations and a light emitting device of organic dye LB film
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Emission light was observed for merocyanine (MC) LB films and hetero films of MC and crystal violet (CV) LB films on silver (Ag) films using the reverse irradiation in the Kretschmann configuration. Emission properties and changes in the spectra due to energy interaction of MC and CV molecules have been investigated using the Ag thin film conventional ATR method and the reverse irradiation. The phenomenon is useful for application to a new luminescent devices and sensors.

articleTitle: Mechanism of surface flashover of electrolyte water channels. I
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper deals with the propagation of the local discharge on liquid under DC high voltage. The tests have been carried out on different resistivity using Obenaus and two grooves model. The electrical parameters of flashover, the critical magnitude of gradient of potential and current in the pollution are compared for both models. The results show almost no difference on their magnitudes. The high gradient is associated with low current and vice versa. The authors comment on these results and suggest an explanation.

articleTitle: AC partial discharges propagating on an unpenetrated crack wall
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The purpose of this study is to make clear the influences of partial discharges (PD) propagating in the walls of an unpenetrated crack. The high densities of charges due to PD are expected to accumulate in the unpenetrated crack. ne unpenetrated crack in this study was formed with walls of opposed two insulator blocks (PMMA) on an insulating board (PMMA). Two blocks on the board were set in the needle-plate electrode system. AC high voltage (30 kV, 50 Hz) was applied to a needle electrode. The crack width studied ranged from 10 /spl mu/m to 1000 /spl mu/m. The length of the crack mainly studied was 40 mm. The results indicate that the PD propagation into the crack is strictly changed at a critical width of the crack. When the crack width is from 10 /spl mu/m to 200 /spl mu/m, strong positive pulses with Q>2/spl times/10/sup -8/ C appears. When the crack width s>500 /spl mu/m, the strong positive pulses disappears. The critical width exists between 200 /spl mu/m and 500 /spl mu/m. Negative pulses of relatively high magnitude are observed just before the phase where strong positive pulses appear. The strong positive PD will be generated when the negative pulses neutralize the accumulated positive charge on the wall of the crack.

articleTitle: Frequency dependent AC breakdown and pre-breakdown current of thin polyimide films prepared by vapor deposition polymerization
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Dielectric breakdown of thin polyimide films prepared by vapor deposition polymerization has been investigated for various AC voltages. Real time measurements were made automatically with a system composed of a digital oscilloscope controllable signal generator and microcomputer The AC electric strength decreases with temperature, and it increases with frequency in the range of 10 Hz - 3 kHz, The pre-breakdown current was also measured using the bridge circuit. The very large conductive current and the abnormal current peak due to the polarity reversal were also observed. The frequency dependence of the electric strength has been discussed in terms of the probability of the establishment of the conductive path and the distortion of electric field leading to the breakdown.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of partial discharge in GIS based on UHF sensing technique
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: A gas-insulated substation (GIS) test model was set up and a GIS partial discharge (PD) online detection system by a UHF sensing technique was developed. Investigation was made on the diagnosis of PDs in GIS. Testing with different insulation defects in GIS and comparing between the waveforms of the UHF measurement, the features of the different PDs were investigated, and the PD form recognition was performed. Based on the results of the UHF PD measurement and the conventional PD measurement, the PD quantities of the defects in GIS were estimated.

articleTitle: Study on the development of PD parameters during the process of multi-stress aging of stator winding
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The PD detection technology has been an efficient method to evaluate the condition of solid insulation since its occurrence and is now used widely in the field of electric engineering. In this paper, the development of PD parameters during the process of multi-stress aging of stator winding is studied in order to evaluate the condition of solid insulation of a large generator in service by PD detection technology. The thermal, electrical and mechanical stresses were applied to the specimens of stator bar by the aging system simultaneously. Moreover, a practical anti-corona scheme is adopted to improve the electrical field distribution at the end of specimen and a new measuring electrode system is used to assure the accuracy of PD measurement and the feasibility of long-term multistress aging. The partial discharge is measured before multi-stress aging and after 600 h aging by using HAEFELY TE571 partial discharge analyzer. The PD phase-resolved quantities distribution, time-resolved quantities distribution and three-dimensional distribution were analyzed in this paper. The maximum magnitude, number, energy, current of discharge increase and the center discharge moves to the negative half of the voltage cycle from the positive half according to the discharge three-dimensional distribution. In addition, the phase range of discharge widens apparently.

articleTitle: One-step polymerization of aniline and its conducting blends in organic system
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Stable polyaniline-dodecylbenzenesulfonic acid (PANI -DBSA) fully dissolved in toluene was obtained by a direct one-step emulsion polymerization technique. The polymerization of aniline was carried out in an emulsion comprising water, toluene and DBSA acting both as a surfactant and a dopant for PANI. After the proper washing process was performed, the conductivity of obtained PANI-DBSA complex increased with an increase in the APS/aniline molar ratio and the DBSA/aniline molar ratio. The UV-vis absorption spectra of the PANI-DBSA complex also supported these results. PANI-DBSA/polymer (polystyrene and styrene-butadiene copolymer) blends were prepared by mixing PANI-DBSA complex with polymer in toluene. These blends exhibited relatively high conductivity of 10/sup -2/ S/cm at a low PANI-DBSA content (1-5 wt.%).

articleTitle: The analysis on propagation characteristics of electromagnetic waves excited by PD in GIS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The propagation characteristics of the electromagnetic waves excited by partial discharge (PD) in gas insulated substation (GIS) are analyzed in detail in this paper. The results of the analysis show that electromagnetic waves excited by PD propagate in GIS not only in the transverse electric and magnetic mode (TEM), but also in the high order modes-transverse electric (TE) and transverse magnetic(TM), and that the duration of TE and TM is much longer than that of PD impulse in GIS, and that the leakage of electromagnetic waves will increase owing to supporting insulator, which benefits the method of external antenna to receive UHF signal to detect PD in GIS.

articleTitle: Electrostatic interfacial phenomena and I-V characteristics of Au/polyimide Langmuir-Blodgett film/Al element
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In this paper, we have analyzed the I-V characteristic of metal (Au)-PI LB film-metal (Al) elements, taking into account the interfacial electrostatic phenomena and the existence of the interfacial electric states at the metal/PI LB film interfaces. A modification of the potential barrier height in the Richardson-Schottky model has been made. It is demonstrated that the interfacial electronic states play an important role in determining the I-V characteristic of the Au-PI LB film-Al structure.

articleTitle: 3-dimensional tree simulation considering a barrier interface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Carried out a 3-dimensional tree simulation with a barrier between a point electrode and a plane electrode, based on a DBM model considering the growth probability. It was found that the results obtained from the 3-dimensional tree simulation considering the growth probability are similar to those of actual tree growth in composite insulating materials with a barrier. It was suggested that the 3-dimensional tree simulation considering the growth probability is valid for simulating the growth in composite insulating systems with barriers.

articleTitle: Reduction of micro-scratch using slurry filter in oxide CMP (chemical mechanical polishing) for multi-level interconnections
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) process has been widely used to planarize dielectrics, which can apply to integrated circuits for sub-micron technology. Despite the increased use of CMP process, it is difficult to accomplish the global planarization of free-defects in the inter-level dielectrics (ILD). Especially, defects like micro-scratch lead to severe circuit failure, and affect yield. CMP slurries can contain particles exceeding 1 /spl mu/m size, which could cause micro-scratches on the wafer surface. The large particles in these slurries may be caused by particle agglomeration in slurry supply line. To reduce these defects, filtration has been recommended in oxide CMP. We have systematically studied the effects of filtration and the defect trend as a function of polished wafer count using various filters in inter-metal dielectric (IMD)-CMP process. The filter installation in CMP polisher could reduce defects after IMD-CMP process. Slurry filter plays an important role in determining consumable pad lifetime. The filter lifetime is dominated by the defects. Slurry filter lifetime is fixed by the degree of generating defects.

articleTitle: Morphology change and tree initiation of polyethylene
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Electrical trees are greatly influenced by the morphological structure in semi-crystalline polymers. In this paper, samples of polyethylene (PE) films have been annealed. The electrical tree initiation voltages of these samples also have been measured. It was found that the thickness of lamellae is the important parameter that affects the tree initiation. It was also found that the thermal stability could be related to the thickness of lamellae. It was considered that the larger the thickness of lamellae, the higher the thermal stability, which results in the more difficult tree initiation.

articleTitle: Product stewardship for SF/sub 6/
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The manufacturers in the chemical industry are committed to minimize any health, safety and environmental risks which may be related to their products and, at the same time, to meet the needs of their customers and the public for safely usable and environmentally sustainable products. In the framework of their commitment for continuous progress in these matter within the RESPONSIBLE CARE programme the concept of PRODUCT STEWARDSHIP has become an important building block towards sustainable development. Product responsibility for SF/sub 6/ is materialized in a large number of practical precautions which Solvay Fluor und Derivate has developed and implemented in collaboration with, but always for, the users of SF/sub 6/.

articleTitle: Acoustic detection of defects and aging for stator bar insulation of large generator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: A set of acoustic detection facility developed by our research group is used to investigate defects and aging in stator bar insulation, which have been subjected to electrical, thermal and mechanical stresses for 1000 hours, respectively. The acoustic signal analysis in time domain, frequency domain and wavelet transform at four different scales has been conducted, respectively. It is observed that frequency components concentrate mainly about 1 kHz for specimens unaged, while shift to 2 kHz for specimens subjected to electrical stress or mechanical stresses. A new high frequency component at 6 kHz is characteristic of the specimens subjected to thermal stress. It is suggested that electrical or mechanical stress aging would lead to decrease in block density of insulation with epoxy/mica and thermal aging should be contributed to delamination of the insulation. This acoustic detection system is effective for finding defects in stator winding insulation of generator.

articleTitle: Effect of poly(trifluoropropylmethylvinylsiloxane) additive on the surface properties of polydimethylsiloxane applied to outdoor insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper describes the effect of blending of poly(trifluoropropylmethylvinylsiloxane) (PTFPMVS) with poly(dimethylsiloxane) (PDMS) on the surface properties of the blend, such as hydrophobicity. We have investigated the surface molecular mobility of the PDMS/PTFPMVS blends via dynamic contact angle measurements and adhesion tension relaxation. We found that a flexible side-chain segment in PTFPMVS which imparts high surface energy could be reoriented easily in water to decrease the interfacial tension of the polymer/water interface. This surface functionality seems to play a major role in the decrease of receding contact angle and the surface resistivity of PDMS/PTFPMVS blends during wet electrical aging.

articleTitle: Effect of the electric pre-stress to dielectric property of epoxy polymer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In this paper, effect of the electric pre-stress applied during solidifying of epoxy resins on dielectric properties of epoxy polymer was studied. Preliminary study shows that the electric pre-stress can change dielectric properties of epoxy polymer. The possible mechanisms of the electric pre-stress were discussed.

articleTitle: Effect of facility for hot spot reduction of inter-level dielectric (ILD) CMP process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) process is widely used for global planarization of inter-level dielectric (ILD) for sub-micron technology. But the hot-spot due to partial over-polishing was generated in the edge of wafers, and became a major concern. Thus, it is very important to understand the correlation between ILD-CMP process and various facility factors of CMP equipment system. With facility shortage of deionized water (DIW) pressure, we introduced an adding purified N/sub 2/ (PN/sub 2/) gas in polishing head cleaning station for increasing a cleaning effect. Our experimental results show that DIW pressure and PN/sub 2/ gas factors were not related with removal rate, but edge hot-spot of patterned wafer had a serious relation. We estimated two factors (DIW pressure and PN/sub 2/ gas) for the improvement of CMP process. Especially, we obtained a uniform planarity in patterned wafer and prohibited more than 90% of wafer edge over-polishing. Finally, we suggest that the facility factors supplied to equipment system play an important role in ILD-CMP process.

articleTitle: Distribution characteristics of salt contaminants
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In this paper, the distribution characteristics of salt contaminants with the distance from sea in South Korea were investigated to evaluate the suitability of KEPCO's design standard for contamination. To measure the equivalent salt deposit density (ESDD), the conventional brush wiping method was used for about 150 sites, most of which were distributed near to coast. Because the measuring period is short, the measured value is much lower than that of the design standard. So, the data should take the statistical treatment, such as regression, time series, and so forth. But, with the consideration for the number and property of data, normalizing method was adapted in this study. From the result of statistical analysis, we could know the distribution characteristics of salt contaminants with the distance from the East and West Sea. In the past investigation, with the consulting for the research result of Japan, the accumulation property of contaminant has been ignored. But, through the analysis for the precipitation pattern and actual measurement, we could set the range of accumulation factor for salt pollution. And, from the analysis for accident, we could confirm the validity of the result of this investigation, the degree of contamination with the distance from sea.

articleTitle: Interfacial charge behavior in SXLPE/XLPE laminate
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Space charge distributions in silane crosslinked polyethylene (SXLPE)/crosslinked polyethylene (XLPE) laminates were investigated using a pulsed electroacoustic (PEA) method. XLPE shows heterocharge while SXLPE shows homocharge. Positive charge is accumulated at the interface of SXLPE/XLPE laminate when the applied electric field is more than 20 kV/mm. The charge profile at various temperatures was also acquired using a temperature-controllable PEA system. Although the applied electric field is only 8.6 kV/mm, positive interfacial charge starts to appear near 50/spl deg/C.

articleTitle: Anomalous creeping flashover characteristics in N/sub 2//SF/sub 6/ mixtures and effect of barrier surface
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Creeping flashover characteristics have been investigated for an N/sub 2//SF/sub 6/ composite insulating system consisting of insertion of an insulating barrier between the needle electrode and the plane electrode. The negative flashover voltage (FOV) for the flat and stepped systems in N/sub 2/ (D=0%) is as high as that of SF/sub 6/ (D=0%) by the effective field relaxation from the accumulated charges. Remarkable reduction of FOV induced by few percentages SF/sub 6/ addition should originate from the barrier interaction such as ineffective charge accumulation and photon-related emission. However, for the grooved system, the confinement effect should be effective, resulting in lower FOV in N/sub 2/.

articleTitle: The structural properties of BaTiO/sub 3/+xNb/sub 2/O/sub 5/ ceramics
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The BaTiO/sub 3/+xNb/sub 2/O/sub 5/ [x=6, 8, 10 wt%] ceramics were prepared by conventional mixed oxide method. The structural properties of the BaTiO/sub 3/+xNb/sub 2/O5 ceramics with the sintering temperature and addition of Nb/sub 2/O/sub 5/ were investigated by XRD and SEM. Increasing the sintering temperature, the 2/spl otimes/ value of BT [110] peak was shifted to the lower degree and intensity of the BN [310] peak was increased. Increasing the addition of Nb/sub 2/O/sub 5/, the intensity of BN [100] peak was decreased and BN [310], [110] peaks were increased. The grain size of the BaTiO/sub 3/+Nb/sub 2/O/sub 5/ ceramics sintered at 1500/spl deg/C were almost uniform. In the BaTiO/sub 3/+10wt%Nb/sub 2/O/sub 5/ ceramics sintered at 1450/spl deg/C, the density was 31.97 [g/cm/sup 3/].

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on electric field and taping for stator coil with global insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The electrical and mechanical characteristics of our global insulation system (F-resin/G II insulation system) have been introduced in the several papers. In order to perform the optimal insulation design, a quantitative analysis of stator coil with global VPI insulation of generators is required, and therefore electric field strength of current coils was analyzed utilizing the finite element method (FEM) in this time. In the other hand, quality of coil insulation is dependent upon not only materials used but also manufacturing method. In particular, since a taping method of insulation affects the break down voltage (BDV) of coils, the optimum state thereof should be seized. Based on the above, the optimum state of taping was determined through a unique analysis program. The numerical analysis results are reflected to current stator coils with global insulation system contributing to the upgrading of insulation.

articleTitle: Partial discharge acoustic emission detector based on computer for power capacitor
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: A computer-based digital measuring system for detecting partial discharge (PD) within a power capacitor is introduced in this paper. The principle and construction of this instrument and some results obtained from typical discharge experiments are given. The electrical signal caused by PD in a capacitor with large capacity is very weak; therefore this system is based on acoustic emission (AE) method and detects the acoustic pulse signal caused by PD. Mass capacity, high-speed synchronous A/D (analog/digital) converter cards are used to record the acoustic signals and this makes the subsequence processing possible. Through a series of processing, the frequency spectrum of PD signals, the discharge waveform information and the PD characteristic reflected by /spl phi/-q-n chart (/spl phi/: occurring phase, q: discharge amplitude, n: repetitive rate) could be extracted. Some feature extracting methods such as waveform feature analysis, frequency spectrum analysis and artificial neural network used as a classification tool are applied to recognize the discharge pattern. The study results could provide reference for a factory to improve manufacturing technologies.

articleTitle: Development of insulation diagnosis in P.R. China
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The authors review developments in the methodology of insulation diagnosis and maintenance in China. Topics discussed include: preventive testing and time based maintenance; condition based maintenance, including condition monitoring and synthetic analysis; and progress in testing and monitoring, including DGA, furfural testing, on-site PD testing and monitoring, detection of winding deformation, countermeasures for on-line monitoring, and expert systems for insulation diagnosis.
