articleTitle: A cable terminator for partial discharge and dielectric loss measurements
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: This paper presents the design of a cable connector used in partial discharge and dielectric loss tests. The body of the connector is constructed using an acrylic tube and PVC, and oil is used as an insulating medium. In order to implement the connector, partial discharges and the dielectric loss (tan /spl delta/) of a cable are tested according to IEC standards. It is found that the cable connector proposed can give satisfactory and reasonably accurate results from the measurements. In addition, the cost of the construction of the connector developed is cheaper than that of the commercial module.

articleTitle: Electrical properties of organic single electron tunneling device
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: We made Au/PI/(Rh-G2 + PI)/PI/Au junctions and Au/PI/(Rh-G2 + PI)/PI/Al junctions with an artificially layered structure containing rhodamine dendrite macromolecules (Rh-G2), and then observed steps in their I-V characteristic. It is found that the device using organic monomolecule, Rh-G2 dendrite molecule, function as a single electron tunnel device. It was concluded that the presence of metal/organic interfacial states made a significant contribution to the I-V characteristics of these junctions.

articleTitle: Advanced PD noise suppression and its relevance for computer aided PD defect identification
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: Digital partial discharge (PD) defect identification has become state of the art. But computer aided procedures based on pattern recognition principles are negatively effected by pulse-shaped disturbances. It is pointed out that a sufficient noise suppression and noise resistivity is a must for automated diagnosis. A novel approach is presented, which improves the defect identification on-site at noisy conditions. The benefits and limits of expert diagnosis compared to machine intelligent systems are discussed. Experimental results are presented, taken into account hard- and software noise suppression components. It is shown that PD defect identification at operating voltages and respectively disturbed data is still a challenge. A method of resolution with an intelligent neural noise filter and noise resistant diagnosis concepts are discussed.

articleTitle: Swedish research program on high performance outdoor electrical insulation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: In Sweden, the use of polymeric insulators is today very sparse and the knowledge related is limited. It is therefore of vital importance for Swedish electrical utilities and manufacturers to develop new knowledge in this rapidly evolving field and maintain their leading international position. Due to the interdisciplinary nature of the field, the knowledge is best achieved with joint efforts of chemists, physicists, and electrical and mechanical engineers. The authors describe the present research on nonceramic insulation, aiming to optimise insulator performance, which has a very strong coupling to other engineering fields in which polymeric materials are used.

articleTitle: Insight into technologies in electrical insulation toward the middle of the 21/sup st/ century
publicationTitle: Proceedings of 2001 International Symposium on Electrical Insulating Materials (ISEIM 2001). 2001 Asian Conference on Electrical Insulating Diagnosis (ACEID 2001). 33rd Symposium on Electrical and Ele
abstract: The paper describes an insight into technologies in electrical insulation toward the middle of the 21/sup st/ century on the basis of the detailed analysis and synthesis of social and technical requirements for power delivery business. It is concluded that the following categories of R&D should be taken into consideration: (1) Cost Reduction and Quality Improvement of Matured Technologies, (2) Substitute and Improved Technologies for Environmental Protection, (3) Advanced Technologies and Materials for New System Approach, (4) Aging & Degradation and Fundamental Performances, and (5) Methods for LCA Evaluation and Modern Maintenance.
